subject: AWS SI co-sell demo — calendar handoff, shadow host request & preflight
messages:
From: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@siemens-systems.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2028-03-08T09:04:00Z
Subject: RW demo — proposing Janus build walkthrough + SI shadow host

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. Siemens is excited to walk through the Janus integration we built on top of Redwood inference. AWS has offered to co-host and route a short technical demo to highlight multi-region failover and the dedicated capacity behavior.

Two asks from our side before we lock a time:
- Can Redwood provide a shadow host (someone to act as facilitator and field Redwood-specific questions during the demo)?
- Any preflight checklist or runbook we should run through with our SI and AWS SAs prior to the call?

Tentative audience: Siemens SRE + platform PM (3), AWS Partner SA (2), Siemens sales (1). Target duration 45–60 minutes.

Propose week of Mar 13 (CEST) — any availability that week for a joint dry run?

Thanks,
Michael Lowe
Principal Solutions Architect
Siemens Systems

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@siemens-systems.com>
Cc: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@aws-partner.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-08T12:17:00Z
Subject: Re: RW demo — proposing Janus build walkthrough + SI shadow host

Michael — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to coordinate. Quick notes: 

- We can provide a shadow host; I'll nominate Vanessa as the primary facilitator and Kim as backup for deep infra questions.
- Attaching our preflight checklist and a slim runbook (see attachments). It's a short ops checklist + recommended slide order for the demo.
- For the dry run, Vanessa is available Mar 14 14:00–16:00 CEST and Mar 15 09:00–11:00 CEST. Kim can join either slot.

Next steps: please confirm preferred demo slot and whether AWS wants an additional 30-minute run-through just for SAs. Also confirm if the demo will show the dedicated Redwood Dedicated pool (yes/no) so we surface the correct telemetry.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf, co-sell-runbook-links.txt
From: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@aws-partner.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@siemens-systems.com>
Date: 2028-03-08T13:03:00Z
Subject: Re: RW demo — proposing Janus build walkthrough + SI shadow host

Thanks Ben — Angela from AWS here. We appreciate the checklist. Quick answers: 
- AWS SAs would like a separate 30-minute run-through the day before the public demo to validate VPC peering and cross-account routing.
- Preferred public demo slot for Siemens is Mar 15 at 15:00 CEST (Siemens team confirmed on their side).
- Confirming we want Redwood to show the Dedicated pool telemetry, plus a short bit on failover (10 mins).

Can Vanessa lead the dry run with our SAs + Siemens SREs on Mar 14 15:00 CEST? If that works, we'll lock the public demo on Mar 15 15:00 CEST.

—Angela
Senior Partner Solutions Architect — AWS Partner Network
angela.ruiz@aws-partner.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@aws-partner.com>, Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@siemens-systems.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-08T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: RW demo — proposing Janus build walkthrough + SI shadow host

Angela — that works. Vanessa will run the Mar 14 dry run at 15:00 CEST. Kim and I will join as observers and to help with any infra follow-ups.

Vanessa — can you confirm the dry-run invite and attach the preflight checklist in the calendar event? Also calling out two small items we want Siemens to validate before the run: 
1) a test corpus that exercises multi-session caching (we recommended ~10 short conversation traces).
2) a short S3 file (500MB) on the Siemens test bucket to exercise the streaming fallback path (we can provide an upload link).

I'll send a one-pager to Siemens with those artifacts and the calendar invites.

Thanks — Ben

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@siemens-systems.com>, Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@aws-partner.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-10T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: RW demo — proposing Janus build walkthrough + SI shadow host

Michael/Angela — invite sent: Mar 14 15:00–16:00 CEST (dry run) and Mar 15 15:00–16:00 CEST (public demo). See calendar links below and attached runbook.

Quick operational notes included in the event:
- Dial-in: Zoom link (passcode in event).
- Run order: Siemens intro (5), Redwood overview (10), Janus deep dive (20), failover demo (10), Q&A (15).
- Kim will monitor telemetry and Slack channel #partners-siemens during the public demo.
- Artifacts: I uploaded a 500MB test file to Siemens test bucket (link in the event) and placed the example conversation traces in the shared Drive folder.

Looking forward — we will join the dry run 10 minutes early to validate audio and screen sharing.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf, co-sell-runbook-links.txt
